notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/76a914e167985ef209d923aa75c576f093881750.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for playing Passenger: Gone Early Access.[/p][p]We completed this update on September 27, 2025. The details are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p]Balance Adjustments[/p][p]1.Reduced monster strength in Ashen Coast, Mist, Relic and Oranbato.[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][p]Experience Improvements[/p][p]1.Added achievements for the Candle World. Memory Collection achievements already fulfilled will now trigger when collecting a memory again.[/p][p]2.Added Cloud Save support.[/p][p]3.The game’s display frame rate is now locked at 60 FPS.[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][p]Known Issues[/p][p]1.Certain effects in battle may cause card-play errors. This issue will be fixed in the v1.0.2 test build.[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][p]v1.0.2 Preview[/p][p][/p][p]We are close to completing the core content for v1.0.2, and expect to release its test version on October 9, 2025.[/p][p]This test will be available separately from v1.0.1. Instructions on how to download the test build via Steam will be included in the update announcement.[/p][p][/p][p]The v1.0.2 test build will share the same save data with the main game, and after testing ends, you can continue to use the same save file in the official version.[/p][p]In this test, we will introduce the new boss Anugus, the Trueflame Dragon, along with its domain Candlepeak Volcano, as the first challenge content.[/p][p]Enocilv and Ael will be available as the first playable characters.[/p][p][/p][p]In later test updates, we plan to:[/p][p]Add 1–2 new characters per week[/p][p]Add 1 new world boss and its map every two weeks[/p][p]Periodically introduce new random events, map events, echoes, and relics[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]For any issues with the version, please use the Feedback Page located at the bottom left of the in-game exit menu to send us your thoughts.[/p][p]We will continue to pay close attention to your feedback and deliver content that provides a better gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update – September: Part 1

notes.title: Q3 Update Plan
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/76a914e167985ef209d923aa75c576f093881750.png"][/img][/p][p]First of all, thank you all for your support of [i]Passenger: Gone[/i].[/p][p]  Because we truly want everyone to experience more content as soon as possible, we will be focusing our development efforts in August and September on new version content. The current game content will receive unscheduled updates mainly for bug fixes during this time.[/p][p][/p][p]  If all goes well, we aim to release the game mode for the second world by the end of September. Along with it, we will also roll out adjustments to the first world, including monster and card balancing, new achievements, cloud saves, and other quality-of-life improvements. These changes are designed to make the deck-building combat mechanics more engaging, enhance the differences between characters, and make it easier to get started.[/p][p][/p][p]  That’s our upcoming update plan—we hope you’re looking forward to it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]And finally, a brief preview of the second world:[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]1、The Delta World will feature multiple entirely distinct maps[/b], each with its own unique boss for players to challenge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/c3fba766bfe02a7bd550cbdfcc05197912a89af3.png"][/img][/p][p]  You’ll be able to freely plan your exploration path on the world map, collecting memories, relics, and echoes to strengthen yourself and ultimately defeat the boss of each map.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]2、In the Delta World, elemental effects are completely reworked[/b], and both the number and capabilities of playable characters will change significantly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/c7cb14d8c78484fa71fd057052069bbd5e9789ff.png"][/img][/p][p]  The focus will shift more towards the growth of your chosen character, enabling clearer deck-building directions and offering deeper strategic choices through richer gameplay mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p]  Beyond that, the Delta World will offer many experiences that are fundamentally different from the Candle World, and we can’t wait to bring them to life.[/p][p][/p][p]  If we make any exciting progress, we’ll share it with you as soon as possible. We also warmly encourage players with creative ideas to send us feedback via the in-game exit page (bottom-left corner) or by email. We truly value every piece of feedback and will continue striving to do better.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/76a914e167985ef209d923aa75c576f093881750.png"][/img]
Thank you for participating in the early access test of "逝去之物 Passenger: Gone".[/p][p]This update will complete on July 13, 2025, and includes the following changes:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where A Fog Shrouded effect in the [i]Mist[/i] region, and other region effects that increase damage reduction, had actual values lower than displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [i]Expected Damage[/i] function did not include Card Damage in the initial calculation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused card click failures after being affected by enemy discard effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional issues where cards could not be clicked during battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the battle result screen would skip Remnants selection when no new Memories were available or the stage did not provide Memories.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential freeze on the battle result screen when no Echoes were available to obtain.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the display limit for Remnants to prevent incomplete display when too many are acquired.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the display limit for Relics to prevent incomplete display when too many are acquired.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p][b]Balance Adjustments:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Increased the probability of Memories upgrading to Legendary quality in stages where rare Memories drop.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the number of turns required to obtain bonus rewards in certain stages.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p][b]Experience Improvements:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]In the character interface, hovering over a Memory with the mouse will now show its description.[/p][/*][*][p]During battle, the right side now shows the remaining Memories that can be drawn this round.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the display of the hand limit indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized reward display rules on the battle result screen—only unlockable Memories will be shown if the player lacks sufficient Memory slots.[/p][/*][*][p]The first-layer Epic Remnants reward in each region can now be freely selected: you may now choose one of five Remnants based on your deck strategy to add to your inventory.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]If you encounter any issues with this version, feel free to open the [b]Feedback Page[/b] from the bottom-left corner of the in-game exit menu and send us a message. We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and deliver updates that enhance the overall experience.[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update – July: Part 1
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/b363b91d6117fd607cc9d05c605bb5944c3d7b7c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to the content preview for the first update in July. We will release this update on July 13, 2025. For full patch notes, please refer to the official update announcement on that day.[/p][p][/p][h3]In this update, we plan to fix the following issues:[/h3][p][/p][p]1\\ Certain situations in battle where cards become unresponsive or trigger incorrectly[/p][p]2\\ Discrepancies between effect descriptions and actual performance in some areas[/p][p]3\\ Missing deck status indicators during battle[/p][p]4\\ Display issues caused by insufficient slots for Remnants and Relics[/p][p]5\\ Possible freeze when acquiring Memories after battle ends[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we plan to implement the following quality-of-life improvements:[/p][p][/p][p]1\\ Excessive randomness in the first-floor Echoes of late-stage levels (e.g. post-Ashen Coast), leading to inconsistent player experiences  [/p][p]2\\ Lack of keyword/explanation prompts during early game progression[/p][p]3\\ Large deviation between actual battle time and the estimated duration in bonus reward encounters[/p][p][/p][p]Before each regular update, we will publish a preview during the second week of the month. If you have any questions about upcoming content, feel free to contact us.  [/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to address other known issues in future updates. Thank you for all your feedback and support.  [/p][p][/p][p]If you have suggestions, feedback, or expectations for future updates, you’re welcome to contact us in-game or by email. [/p][p]We firmly believe that better communication with players—and creating content that truly meets your needs—is the key to realizing the value of our game.  [/p][p][/p][p]Contact Email: [url="https://936320583@qq.com"]936320583@qq.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/76a914e167985ef209d923aa75c576f093881750.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for participating in the early access test of "逝去之物 Passenger: Gone".[/p][p]This update will complete on June 29, 2025, and includes the following changes:[/p][p][/p][p]---  [/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes: [/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where duplicate values were retained in historical data. These will now be cleaned when entering the world map. [/p][p]2. Fixed a bug where non-combat choice timeouts prevented time nodes from activating on the world map. [/p][p]3. Fixed a bug where Oranbato, Caprock, and EternalVortex remained available after time expired. [/p][p]4. Fixed an issue where Final Ancient Ruins could not be unlocked after progressing past the Great Rift if time had expired. [/p][p]5. Fixed a UI display issue when obtaining Witnesses. [/p][p]6. Fixed an issue where a single attribute could be upgraded more than 20 times upon leveling up. [/p][p]7. Fixed an incorrect suppression effect in Oranbato. [/p][p]8. Fixed missing icons in Past Presents display. [/p][p]9. Fixed an issue where Divinia’s HP would drop to 1 after reviving with "Collapse And Overturn". [/p][p]10. Fixed an issue where People, Barrier Maintainers, and Broken Cadaver would not properly use their powerful attacks.[/p][p][/p][p]---  [/p][p][/p][p]Balance Adjustments: [/p][p]1. To better reflect character identity, Oplora’s abilities — Shadowy Soul, Furlough, Fracture In Space, Die Of Sorrow, Contractual, and Time Of Death — have been reclassified from Shadow type to Flare type. [/p][p]2. Die Of Sorrow now deals "1 fixed Flare damage and resets attack state" instead of "1 fixed Shadow damage and resets attack state". [/p][p]3. Effects described as "XX fixed damage" now ignore all elemental and attribute modifiers, rather than being influenced only by their element. [/p][p]4. Void Barrier effect reduced: now grants +65 damage reduction until next action (was +100). 5. Increased enemy Attack by 50% and HP by 15% in Caprock and EternalVortex to improve challenge pacing.  [/p][p][/p][p]---  [/p][p][/p][p]Quality of Life Improvements: [/p][p]1. The character info screen now includes damage formulas for all elements for players to reference. [/p][p]2. During battle, clicking a Memory now displays its expected damage on the left panel. (Note: this does not account for the target’s stats.)[/p][p]3. Elemental suppression effects are now shown in both the battle info screen and the character’s status bar during combat.  [/p][p][/p][p]--- [/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues with this version, please visit the Feedback Page located in the bottom-left corner of the pause menu.  [/p][p]We will continue listening to your suggestions and strive to deliver an even better experience.   [/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update Notice
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/76a914e167985ef209d923aa75c576f093881750.png"][/img][/p][p]First of all, we sincerely apologize that the originally scheduled update for June 22 has been postponed to June 29, 2025 at 11:00 (UTC+8) due to health-related reasons.[/p][p][/p][h3]In this update, we aim to address the following issues:[/h3][p]1\\ Certain card descriptions do not match their actual in-game effects.[/p][p]2\\ The current damage calculation logic for "fixed XX damage" is unreasonable.[/p][p]3\\ Spacetime Endpoint cannot be entered as intended.[/p][p]4\\ Abnormal effects on certain Legendary Relics.[/p][p][/p][h3]In addition, we plan to implement the following experience improvements (subject to the final patch notes):[/h3][p]1\\ Some stage enemies — notably those in Ashen Shore — have overly strong buffs at the beginning of battle.[/p][p]2\\ Card damage previews and contributing factors are not intuitive enough.[/p][p][/p][p]For future routine updates (including bug fixes and experience optimizations), we aim to follow a biweekly schedule — releasing updates every 14 days.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking Ahead: New World “Delta” in Q4[/p][p]In Q4 of 2025, we will introduce a brand new world — Delta — featuring new characters and new gameplay systems.[/p][p]Our goal for the new gameplay is to significantly reduce reliance on pre-built decks and relic grinding, introducing instead a fresh gameplay loop that emphasizes randomness and fun. It will share little with the current game structure — in fact, it could even be considered a different game — and is designed to offer much higher replayability and more engaging mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank You for Playing[/p][p]
We deeply appreciate your support and interest in our game. We hope to bring you an even better experience in the future.

If you have any feedback — or suggestions and expectations for upcoming updates — feel free to contact us in-game or via email.

We firmly believe that better communication with players and delivering content that truly meets your needs is the key to realizing the full potential of this game.

Contact Email: [url="https://936320583@qq.com"]936320583@qq.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Passenger:Gone Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
[h1]Passenger:Gone Demo Now Available[/h1]

[h2]Map Content:[/h2]

This demo features Chapter One: Ashen Coast, and when Collapse Time reaches zero, the world map will reveal the Spacetime Terminus: Great Gulch.

[h3]Chapter One: Ashen Coast[/h3]

On this dim coastline, as night deepens, shadows of the past that refuse to fade begin to manifest from the air.
At the end of this 10-layer journey, the king who embraced the faith of the Holy Light awaits on a throne long turned to dust.

[h3]Spacetime Terminus: Great Gulch[/h3]

Within the Great Rift where war was halted, the last embers still burn.
The past, present, and future of the Three Sages shall all be witnessed here.

[h2]Character Content:[/h2]

This demo includes 2 initial characters and 3 unlockable characters:

[h2]Initial Characters:[/h2]

[h3]Freesia[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/eb60188b937b8619739b5535359a715073f851e5.png[/img]

Role: Damage, Gale, Memory Recharge
A sky traveler from New Tanas, always accompanied by the ever-present wind.
She follows in someone's footsteps, hoping to reclaim a figure from her memories.

[h3]Brynhild[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/10c3e8dc3d45ebbfbf0f0f8e084b2124f50e5004.png[/img]

Role: Damage, Lightning
Even in the mystical land of Lautenheim, the Valkyries hold a place of honor.
Born from lightning and fallen into it, she swims against the current in the icy waters of River Takigawa, seeking once more the tenderness hidden beneath her armor.

[h2]Unlockable Characters:[/h2]

[h3]Izumi[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/1a1bde4418bdccba0d0a6864fd1c8efce1f28128.png[/img]

Role: Defense, Frost

[h3]Enosylph[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/f8f3ab3b59b4f72db785114288595248c69b4ab3.png[/img]

Role: Defense, Damage, Earth

[h3]Ael[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549467/cc7136021785d12c04bc0a374e90637c9cebba6f.png[/img]

Role: Crue, Flare, Memory Recharge

Finally, thank you for playing Passenger:Gone Demo.
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us at:
936320583@qq.com
